public.scope: Full pinned CosQA corpus, pre-registered positive query subset. Lexical + installed cross-encoders, no embeddings, AST navigation, query variants, Decision or answer generation. Labels only measure retrieved documents; returned-unit completeness does not establish complete answer evidence. Baseline keeps current shared recall/inference modules. Individual stage ranks separate evaluated-model ranking from host fallback slot preservation. No full benchmark claim. Both rerankers are sequential resident models on one local machine with alternating base old/new order; concurrent Sol setup/research ran during part of evaluation. No controlled hardware throughput study, significance test, Decision calibration or full answer-quality evaluation. Complete-return checks compare exact unit byte digests, not completeness of answer prerequisites.

registration.selection: Positive query IDs 51..100 in ascending SHA256 order; no overlap with the preceding 50. Registered before implementation, retrieval or model scoring. Full corpus, labels only on evaluation side.
